title: The Phase-Independent Confocal Ellipse Identity |T_n(d,t)|^2 - |T_n(0,t)|^2 = 4n^{-1}sinh^2(d omega_n), the Three-Part u-Domain Bridge Identity, and Explicit Rosser-Schoenfeld Stieltjes Bounds
description: Paper IX of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Establishes the exact three-part u-domain bridge identity for Xi(t-id)E_X(s) and quadratic Wronskian boundary damping Delta C_n(d,t) = 2 sinh^2((1/2)d omega_n(t)) -> 0 at the saddle-point horizon n -> N_*(t), derives explicit closed-form Rosser-Schoenfeld and Dusart Stieltjes upper bounds across the infinite domain [10^8, inf) alongside the exact algebraic sinh^2 ratio identity <= n^{-d}, proves the phase-independent symplectic confocal ellipse identity |T_n(d,t)|^2 - |T_n(0,t)|^2 = 4n^{-1}sinh^2(d omega_n(t)) with uniform phase-blind L^1 closure for all d > 1/4, and synthesizes the three-domain architecture [0, 55] U [55, 10^8] U [10^8, inf) with a rigorous 12-row Category A/B/C epistemic audit.
